title: Standing Order Terms of the Self-Pay Supply Subscription (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
## Terms of the standing order

1. **What ships.** On the Self-Pay Supply Subscription of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, with automatic shipments chosen, the standing order ships the cushion item of the recorded mask style on its cycle as a self-pay line charged to the card on file, once the cushion supply on the enrollment is within the schedule's ship-window days of running out.
2. **Refill confirmation.** A standing-order line on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription for a patient who chose automatic shipments ships on its cycle without a refill confirmation, while a line that rests on a refill confirmation still ships no later than the schedule's refill lead days after it, counting calendar days from the day after the confirmation date with the boundary day included, and an older confirmation needs a new contact; whether a coverage-billed line must rest on a refill request still follows the program's general refill confirmation rule, and a no-charge reship, which answers the line it replaces, is not held to this window.
3. **How it travels.** A standing-order line travels expedited when the patient asks for faster shipping of it, is collected at a branch when the patient asks to collect it, and otherwise travels by ground.
4. **Style.** A standing-order cushion line is booked only after the recorded mask style matches the style that the patient's own interface and cushion lines establish.

## Clause 2 at its boundary (hypothetical dates, 30 lead days)

A line resting on a refill confirmation dated 1 April: day 1 is 2 April and day 30 is 1 May. Shipping on 1 May meets the clause; shipping on 2 May is too late, and a new contact is needed. A standing-order line for a patient who chose automatic shipments needs no confirmation at all.

## Booking the line — `book_subscription_line_cd282959`

**Capability.** `book_subscription_line_cd282959` books one self-pay standing-order line of a PAP supply item on the patient's supply enrollment, shipping today and charged to the patient's card on file. One call creates one shipped item line dated today carrying the item, the units, the amount charged to the card and the last day of use the units cover; it is never billed to a coverage record. The line then appears in the enrollment's shipment history and the amount is recorded as charged to the card on file on the ship date.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_subscription_line_cd282959` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `hcpcs_code` | the supply item shipped | one of A7030 (full face mask), A7031 (full face mask cushion), A7034 (nasal mask or nasal pillows interface), A7032 (nasal mask cushion), A7033 (pair of nasal pillows), A7035 (headgear), A7036 (chinstrap), A7037 (standard tubing), A4604 (heated tubing), A7038 (disposable filter), A7039 (non-disposable filter), A7046 (humidifier water chamber); `none` never applies to an item line and is not accepted |
| `quantity` | the units of the item shipped on the line | a non-negative integer |
| `self_pay_amount` | the amount charged to the patient's card for the line | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent half up |
| `covers_through_date` | the last day of use the units shipped cover | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `shipping_method` | how the shipment travels | `ground` (the standard carrier), `expedited` (the faster paid service the patient asked for), `branch_pickup` (the patient collects it at a Summit Ridge branch); `none` never applies to a shipped item and is not accepted |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `shipped` when the line was written; `resupply_line_id` is the reference number of the new line; `hcpcs_code` and `quantity` echo the item and units; `self_pay_amount` is the amount charged to the card in USD with 2 decimal places; `service_from_date` is today's ship date (YYYY-MM-DD); `covers_through_date` echoes the last day covered (YYYY-MM-DD); `billing_basis` is `self_pay`.
